architecture_change: Lesion-only control for the two-query generalization experiment: PaperWidthLevel0OneQueryMaskDecoder (paper-matched widths, no canvas bottleneck), fresh initialization, trained ONLY on ischemic-stroke lesion masks (Charite/An et al. 2022 dataset -- data_charite subset, 223 train / 31 validation / 77 test subjects, all with real manual lesion annotations, held-out test set matches the paper's own official evaluation split exactly). This decoder has a single query and never sees brain masks -- it exists purely as the single-task baseline that TwoTaskLevel0OneQueryMaskDecoder's joint lesion performance gets compared against. A decoder trained on only one target cannot demonstrate query-conditioned behavior (there is only ever one query value it handles), so this run does not test the query mechanism itself -- only whether the frozen encoder's features support lesion segmentation at all.
